احتملا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَمَلَا (iḥtamalā) /iħ.ta.ma.laː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِحْتَمَلَ (iḥtamala)
# اُحْتُمِلَا (uḥtumilā) /uħ.tu.mi.laː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِحْتَمَلَ (iḥtamala)
# اِحْتَمِلَا (iḥtamilā) /iħ.ta.mi.laː/: second-person dual imperative of اِحْتَمَلَ (iḥtamala)
